versions.changelog: Description and body rewritten around the jobs people search for: image generation, PDF generation, video generation from templates, OG images, social media posts, carousels, thumbnails, invoices, certificates, and the 13 social platforms.;MCP connection first (`openclaw mcp add` + `openclaw mcp login`), REST with an API key as the headless fallback. Every capability names the MCP tool before the REST route.;Capability list and example prompts mirror the Orshot connector listing in the Claude directory.;Social posting section: accounts, render and post in one call, post existing media, held posts, analytics and best time. 1.3.0 covered render plus publish and account listing only.;Safety rules for agents and confirmation notes next to delete routes and workflow runs.;`metadata.openclaw` block (emoji, homepage, `primaryEnv`, `envVars` with `required: false` because OAuth over MCP needs no key).;`Bearer <ORSHOT_API_KEY>` placeholders replaced with `$ORSHOT_API_KEY`, which the ClawHub scanner no longer reads as a hardcoded secret.;SDK installs pinned (`orshot@0.3.1`, `orshot==0.2.0`, `rishimohan/orshot:0.2.0`, `gem orshot -v 0.2.0`).;SKILL.md shrunk from 57 KB to about 16 KB; long material moved to `references/`, loaded on demand.
